routing_source: PAM50 CLAM-MB predictions_ext.npz (proba/pred) + measured PAM50 labels
note: PAM50 prediction -> therapy-axis routing. cost = therapeutic distance on mis-route (step 2A). The model never predicts HER2-enriched, so all true HER2 patients are routed off the antiHER2 axis. No-treatment penalty (predicted Normal-like) = global maximum therapeutic distance 0.765 (global maximum, not the maximum for the true axis).
caveat: PAM50-to-axis mapping (HER2E ~ antiHER2) approximates receptor status
Predicted Normal-like = no treatment, max-distance penalty

ci_method.index_source: predictions_ext_indexed.csv (case_id assigned by row-wise match of npz to manifest PAM50 rows)
